switching_congestion.theorem: For a charge fiber with sector sizes n0,n1 whose switching graph has NMP in both directions, the minimum deterministic image congestion is ceil(max(n0/n1,n1/n0)).
switching_congestion.proof: Pigeonhole gives the lower bound. Scaled Hall/NMP gives a capacitated matching from the larger sector with that ceiling capacity, while the smaller sector injects into the larger.
switching_congestion.control: The best possible global congestion is 2 on L3 and 6 on L4, improving the extremal selector's 3 and 16 but providing no all-size bound.

conditional_entropy.identity: H(logical sector | Q)=E_Q h2(r_Q), where r_Q is conditional Bayes risk.
conditional_entropy.bounds: For 0<=r<=1/2, 2r<=h2(r)<=2 sqrt(r). Therefore 2 R_L <= H(H|Q) <= 2 sqrt(R_L), and H(H|Q)>=eta implies R_L>=eta^2/4.
conditional_entropy.control: Exact finite conditional entropies are reported, but no reviewed fixed-divergence binary-flow theorem lower-bounds them uniformly in size.

canonical_imbalance.control: Canonical L4 contains 96 maximum-imbalance records of sector ratio 6; each minority-one witness has physical switching graph K_{1,6}. Their total physical mass is 21/8192.
canonical_imbalance.boundary: This rejects exact or near-unity every-record balance at finite size, but neither two sizes nor a finite K_{1,6} witness proves unbounded all-size imbalance. No analytic canonical family was established.

primary_source_applicability.source: Mészáros and Morales, Flow polytopes and the Kostant partition function (2012)
primary_source_applicability.supported: integer-flow counts can be represented by Kostant partition functions and flow polytopes
primary_source_applicability.missing: the results concern unrestricted nonnegative integral flows and do not compare bounded binary logical-parity sectors under rough-boundary charge conditioning

primary_source_applicability.source: Kapoor, Mészáros and Setiabrata, Counting integer points of flow polytopes (2019)
primary_source_applicability.supported: Ehrhart and Kostant formulas count lattice points of integral flow polytopes
primary_source_applicability.missing: no size-uniform lower bound on the parity split or conditional logical entropy of the canonical binary square fibers

primary_source_applicability.source: Felsner, Lattice Structures from Planar Graphs (2004)
primary_source_applicability.supported: fixed-outdegree planar orientations form a distributive lattice under full cycle reversals
primary_source_applicability.missing: lattice order does not bound charge-fiber sector ratios or average minority mass

precise_missing_lemma.averaged_balance: There exist eta,delta>0 independent of L such that physical probability at least delta lies on charge fibers with min(N0,N1)/(N0+N1)>=eta.
precise_missing_lemma.entropy_equivalent: Equivalently sufficient is a positive size-uniform lower bound on H(logical sector | measured integer charge).
precise_missing_lemma.congestion_sufficient: A uniformly bounded-congestion switching map on a positive-probability crossing event implies the averaged-balance lemma.

decision.established: Optimal finite switching congestion is exactly 2 on L3 and 6 on L4; canonical L4 realizes physical K_{1,6} star fibers; conditional logical entropy is an exact equivalent asymptotic target with an elementary risk certificate.
decision.not_established: No size-uniform physical congestion, conditional-entropy lower bound, or analytic family with unbounded sector imbalance is proved.
decision.threshold_claim: No square midpoint noncorrectability or decoding-threshold claim is promoted.
